title: Aghora III: The Law of Karma
author: Robert E. Svoboda

adhd.label: Step 1 · Introduction: The Physics of Karma (Sanchita, Prarabdha & Zero Guilt)
adhd.brief: Strips away guilt and superstition, explaining karma as simple momentum physics: how past arrows already in flight (prarabdha) play out while present non-entanglement keeps you free.

adhd.label: Step 2 · Jumps to Ch. 9: Prakriti Siddhi — Playing Your Role 100% Then Dropping the Load
adhd.brief: Jumps to the culmination of the trilogy, where Vimalananda shows how to act with total intensity in the world while keeping your inner core completely unentangled.
